dedupe_keys.name: inner magnetosphere particle transport and acceleration model

description: IMPTAM tracks ions and electrons from the plasma sheet into the inner magnetosphere. It combines drift motion, losses and radial diffusion under time-varying fields to estimate particle distributions relevant to spacecraft environments. The resource is documented by U. Michigan/FMI. The documented physical domain is Magnetosphere / Global Magnetosphere, Magnetosphere / Inner Magnetosphere / RingCurrent; grid spacing, supported periods and cadence depend on this version and its chosen configuration. The documentation links Continuous/RT Run (ISWA data tree), Continuous/RT Run (ISWA layout), Runs-on-Request. A software licence and any external distribution charge are not stated. Results depend on the supplied fields, boundary conditions and solar-wind drivers. The documented space-weather effects make it a potential environmental input for infrastructure hazard exposure and resilience simulations. It is related to platform-nasa-ccmc in this catalogue. The cited documentation is available online; underlying files were not downloaded. Only metadata were checked; numerical accuracy and current service availability remain unverified.
